contentText: For the first time in nearly a decade, President Donald Trump did not attend one of the biggest annual meetings of conservatives. But even in his absence, the Conservative Political Action Conference revolved around him as well as the Iran war which has divided Trump supporters. "The real divide is among men above and under 35 years oid", said Todd Belt, professor and director of Political Management Program at George Washington University, citing a recent poll. Belt said men above 35 remain firm supporters of Trump while those younger no longer are. "It's breaking up the Republican Party," he added.
